fit_SymbolicTransformerRegressor: fit a SymbolicTransformerRegressor on X and Y datasets using a transformer model
predict_SymbolicTransformerRegressor: predict target values from a fitted SymbolicTransformerRegressor using retrieved symbolic trees
retrieve_tree_SymbolicTransformerRegress: retrieve the best symbolic tree from a fitted regressor with optional refinement type filter
get_top_k_features: get the top k most relevant features from X and y using SelectKBest regression scoring
exchange_node_values: exchange node values in a symbolic tree using a dictionary mapping old to new values
